title: QA run · release-18.2.0-manual-set (29/29) · 6679644a · 2026-10-25 · 25 PASS / 4 PARTIAL / 0 FAIL / 0 BLOCKED / 0 NOT-RUN
body:
This is the QA run record for the 18.2.0 release sweep's manual non-P0 set (wave anchor #25807, card T3), for the Version Packages PR #25640. It was run with the `checklist-test` skill following `docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md`.

The set follows the 18.1 precedent (#25479). It holds the `since:v18.x` items that carry no automated pin, plus the unpinned P1 items whose `source[]` cites files changed by the 14 `Clause-②: yes` changesets in #25640. Like #25479, the set was named by hand, not resolved by a single selector. Every id was resolved one at a time with `node scripts/checklist-select.mjs ID --json`, and all 29 came back runnable: none is blocked and none is `planned`. Every item has a verdict (29/29). None of the 29 carries an `automated.ref`, so every clause was driven live.

## Environment fingerprint

- **Framework:** `6679644a1a56b552d6864b125900221823ec78b3` (objectstack `main` head at start, 14:16Z). The tree was clean. `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` and `pnpm build --concurrency=2` passed 76/76. The tree is unreleased, so the CLI and health report 18.1.0.
- **Console:** `.objectui-sha` = `b41ed7f68956c8cfda21bc790548361af81b09ac`, built with `OBJECTUI_DEPS_BUILD_CMD='pnpm exec turbo run build --concurrency=2 --filter=@object-ui/console^...' pnpm objectui:build` ("dist ready … from objectui@b41ed7f68956"). `packages/console/dist/.objectui-sha` equals the pin, so `stale-console-bundle` is ruled out for every console observation. A pin move is in flight (#25810), and the maintainer directed this run to stay on `b41ed7f68956`.
- **App and boot:** `examples/app-showcase`, booted with `OS_PORT=PORT setsid pnpm -C examples/app-showcase exec objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin -p PORT -d file:SCRATCH/BOOT.db`. Each runner had its own port range (41100–41499) and its own file DBs. Seed: `--seed-admin` (admin@objectos.ai) plus the showcase seed.
  - Scratch copies (tar, without `node_modules`, `.objectstack` or `dist`) were used for cli.fresh-install-migrate-apply-first (production `os serve` with `OS_AUTH_SECRET`/`OS_SECRET_KEY`), the connector-degraded twins, the capability shadow/malformed apps, and app-todo `--preset minimal`.
  - `examples/app-showcase/.objectstack/installed-packages/` never existed.
- **Special switches:** `OS_AUTH_TWO_FACTOR=true` for the two-factor items. `OS_SEARCH_PINYIN_ENABLED=false` for the pinyin OFF leg. `OS_AUTOMATION_SCHEDULED_WORK_ENABLED=1` only on one approvals A9 candidate boot.
- **Browser:** Playwright chromium via `executablePath=/opt/pw-browsers/chromium`, with its own context per persona and a form sign-in.
- **Execution:** four runner agents worked in parallel (A: CLI/API/automation · B: identity/search/i18n · C: approvals/automation/formula/notify (mixed) · D: approvals/records/UX/i18n (browser)). `git status` stayed clean, and every server was stopped by process group.
- **Timings:** environment prep took about 22 minutes for the cold tree: `pnpm build` 9 min, then the console build about 13 min, from 14:18Z to 14:40Z. In-run prep (boots, personas, scratch copies) was about 18 runner-minutes. Testing, probes included, was about 100 runner-minutes. Wall clock was 14:16Z to 15:29Z.

**#25626, Create User.** It merged at 15:24Z, after this run's subject was fixed. Under this set's rule it adds no unpinned item. The only P1 item whose `source[]` cites `admin-user-endpoints.ts`, `identity-auth.admin-lifecycle-operations`, carries an `automated.ref`. That item is being run separately on the new head and will be filed as its own record, linked from the close-out comment.

## Per-clause evidence (one line per clause; text oracles)

Labels: `A0`, `A1`, … are `acceptance[0]`, `acceptance[1]`, …; `N0`, … are `negative[0]`, … (zero-based).

### cli.fresh-install-migrate-apply-first
- A0 pass: on an empty DB (no db, `-wal` or `-shm`), `os migrate apply --yes` exits 0, printing `Created/extended 107 table(s)` and the organization-ownership birth marker (shape generation 1). Before any boot, the marker query returns exactly 1 row: `blocking 0`, `advisory 0`, `details.birth.shapeGeneration 1` (= `ORGANIZATION_OWNERSHIP_SHAPE_GENERATION`). After the boot it is the same single row, byte-identical.
- A1 pass: the first `os serve` prints `Server is ready` (not DEGRADED) in production mode, and health answers 200 about 11 s in. The three refusal greps count 0.
- N0 pass: the first serve is not refused.
- N1 skipped: by its own text this negative is the pin's case (b), not this item's fixture (see the accuracy findings).

### access-security.packaged-flow-write-door-parity
- A0 pass: `?layers=true` shows a populated `code` layer and `_packageId com.example.showcase`.
  - `PUT /meta/flow/showcase_urgent_task_alert` → 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE`.
  - With `?package=com.example.showcase` → 403 `ITEM_LOCKED`.
  - The reads before and after are identical.
- A1 pass: `PUT /automation/showcase_urgent_task_alert` → 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` with the same lock text; the read-back is byte-identical.
- A2 pass: `DELETE /automation/…` → 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` ("sealed against removal"); the following GET is 200 and identical.
- A3 pass: nothing mutated. `_status` reads `enabled:true, bound:true`, and an urgent task create took runs from 0 to 1 (completed, `trigger.recordId` = the new task).
- N0 pass: the refusal is the package lock, which differs from the capability tier (Mei gets 403 "requires the `manage_metadata` capability").
- N1 pass: neither `/automation` door returns a 2xx.

### ai.mcp-run-action-exposure-gate
- A0 pass: `run_action showcase_mark_done` is refused (isError) with the opt-in prescription, both with and without `objectName`. The task's status and `updated_at` are unchanged.
- A1 pass: `list_actions {}` returns only `showcase_portfolio_snapshot` (totalCount 1).
- A2 pass: the exposed action returns `accounts:14, projects:5, invoices:12`, which equals the REST totals.
- A3 pass: the `[action-audit] … executes TRUSTED … for user` line names the user.
- A4 pass: `revoke_session` is refused by the system-object guard, both without `objectName` and with `objectName: sys_session`. The victim session stays live.
- N0 pass: the refused call has zero side effects.
- N1 pass: `list_actions` and `run_action` agree.

### api-backend.aggregate-contract-matrix
- A0 pass: all 6 functions, grouped and ungrouped, have 0 mismatches against the local baseline. `count(*)` returns 16 while `count(annual_revenue)` returns 15, using a planted null row. On a boolean field, min/max are the numbers 0/1.
- A1 pass: day, week, month, quarter and year all reconcile. The run was at 14:40Z, UTC.
  - Null dates form one real `null` bucket.
  - Weeks are ISO: 2024-11-24 → 2024-W47, 2024-12-30 → 2025-W01, 2027-01-03 → 2026-W53.
  - Quarter keys read `YYYY-Qn`.
- A2 pass: on an empty `where`, the ungrouped result is count 0, sum 0, avg/min/max null, count_distinct 0; grouped, there are no buckets. A per-measure `filter` empties only its own measure.
- A3 pass: `array_agg` and `string_agg` → 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED` with the retirement text and the `os migrate meta --from 16` prescription. `median` → 400 naming the six functions. A nonexistent field → 400 `INVALID_FIELD`. A non-array → 400.
- A4 pass: the contributor-bound member (recipe) sees 0 seeded rows, and INV-1003 answers 404. Their grouped count is `{draft:1}`, their own row only; the admin's is `{draft:3, paid:5, sent:5}`.
- A5 pass: 11 variant rows. The 5 granularities give 14, 14, 12, 9 and 5 buckets.
- N0 pass, N1 pass.
- N2 pass: `/analytics/query` with day buckets returns identical labels under UTC (driver path, `data.sql` present), America/Los_Angeles and Pacific/Auckland (in-memory path). The #24618 shift does not reproduce.

### automation.trigger-status-contract
- A0 pass: both trigger routes answer identically:
  - unknown → 404 `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`
  - always-fails → 400 `FLOW_FAILED`
  - disabled → 409 `FLOW_DISABLED`
  - no start node → 422 `FLOW_NO_START_NODE`
  - valid → 200

  The `qa-flow-status-doors` recipe provisioned live, every step 2xx.
- A1 pass: `showcase_reassign_wizard` → 200 `{status:'paused', runId, screen.nodeId:'collect'}`, and that run was later resumed to `completed`.
- A2 pass: with `showcase_reassign_wizard` disabled, `POST /api/v1/actions/showcase_task/showcase_bulk_reassign` → 409 `FLOW_DISABLED`. With `showcase_inquiry_purge` disabled, its type:'flow' endpoint `POST /api/v1/apps/showcase/inquiries/purge` → 409. Through `/actions`, a no-start flow → 422. All three doors import `classifyFlowRefusal`.
- A3 pass: the 400 carries `error.details.errorMessage` and `details.summary` at both the trigger door and `/actions`.
- A4 pass on 6 arms, each re-read as still `paused`:
  - missing screen input → 400 `INVALID_SCREEN_INPUT`
  - inputs+output → 400 `INVALID_SIGNAL`
  - inputs+variables → 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED`
  - member → 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`
  - a concurrent resume during a 6 s http node → 409 `RESUME_IN_PROGRESS`
  - unknown or consumed run → 404 `RUN_NOT_FOUND`

  **The 503 `STORE_UNAVAILABLE` arm is blocked(fixture):** no stock trigger reaches it, as the clause says.
- A5 pass: a flow deregistered under a live pause → 404 `RUN_NOT_FOUND` ("Flow … not found for run"). A paused node edited away → 404 ("Suspended node 'collect' no longer exists").
- A6 pass: `@objectstack/client` `trigger`/`execute` reject with httpStatus/code 404/400/409/422, and `resume` with 400/400/403/404, all matching the rows. Paused and valid calls resolve.
- N0–N5 pass.

### automation.packaged-flow-subflow-disable-refusal
- A0 pass: disabling `showcase_notify_owner` → 409 `DELETE_RESTRICTED`, naming caller `showcase_task_done_notify_owner`, ADR-0126 §7.3 and the remedy.
- A1 pass: disabling map child `showcase_one_task_signoff` → 409 naming `showcase_release_signoff`.
- A2 pass: 0 `sys_metadata_activation` rows after the refusals. A caller-driven run completed, and its `call_notify` subflow step succeeded.
- A3 pass: enabling the child → 200, with the caller off and with it armed.
- A4 pass: disable the caller → 200, then the child retry → 200, and the ledger holds both `active:false`. The teardown re-enabled both.
- N0 pass.
- **N1 blocked(fixture):** naming every packaged caller needs a second **packaged** caller. A `?package=`-authored scratch flow counts as deployment-authored, so only a package-loader-installed package can stage one (see the accuracy findings).

### automation.packaged-flow-clone-contract
- A0 pass: `{}`, `{name}` and `{label}` each → 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED` naming the missing field, and no clone is registered.
- A1 pass: the key diff is exactly name, label, `status:'draft'`, plus the absence of `_provenance`, `_packageId` and `_packageVersion`. None of the 10 dropped keys is present, and no ancestry key appears.
- A2 pass: one urgent create took the base runs from 0 to 1 and the clone runs from 0 to 1, for the same recordId. The notice equals `FLOW_CLONE_NOTICE`.
- A3 pass:
  - same name → 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, suggesting `…_copy`
  - unknown source → 404
  - `Bad-Name!` → 400 with the pattern
- A4 pass: the subflow node keeps `config.flowName`.
- A5 pass: a PUT on the clone → 200, and the edit is read back.
- A6 pass: after a cold restart over the same DB, the clone answers GET 200 and `meta/flow` shows `_packageId null`; a new create took the clone runs from 1 to 2. Studio `/_console/studio/~org/automations` (form sign-in) lists both clones under "Organization flows" and opens the designer.
- N0–N2 pass.
- N3 pass: Mei → 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` and anonymous → 401, with no clone created.

### integration-system.connector-degraded-recovery
- A0 pass: in a scratch copy with the MCP fixture script moved away, the boot completes in about 13 s.
  - WARN `Connector registered DEGRADED: showcase_mcp_tools … Connection closed`.
  - The descriptor reads `state:'degraded'`, the reason and `actions:[]`, and it is listed.
- A1 pass: the `transport.kind:'carrier_pigeon'` twin fails at boot (`providerConfig.transport.kind must be 'stdio' or 'http'`) and nothing listens.
- A2 pass: echo dispatch → 400 in 41 ms, quoting the stored degraded reason. That is distinguishable from an unknown connector ("no handler for …").
- A3 pass: retries at +5 s, +10 s and +20 s, with the next announced at 40000 ms. A view publish triggered retry 5, and the next delay was 80000 ms, so backoff was not reset.
- A4 pass: the file was restored with no restart. The next retry logged `recovered connector instance 'showcase_mcp_tools' via provider 'mcp' (1 action(s))`, the descriptor reads `state:'ready'`, and echo → 200 `{upper:'OBJECTSTACK'}`.
- N0 pass, N1 pass.

### approvals.approver-resolution-matrix
- A0 pass: each scratch flow was registered via `POST /api/v1/automation` and fired by a field_zoo create:
  - team → [Mei, Contributor]
  - field `f_users` → [Ada, Mei]
  - manager → [Ada]
  - user → [Mei]
  - org_membership_level owner → [admin]
- A1 pass: department `bu_field_ops` → [Ada, Mei, Contributor], deduplicated. With `bu_west_coast` deactivated → [Ada, Contributor]. An unknown or inactive root warns "expanded to nobody" and goes to admin_rescue.
- A2 pass: `pending_approvers` holds the two ids, and `__resolvedFrom field:f_users` holds the 2-element array.
- A3 pass: role gives the ADR-0090 D3 deprecation WARN, and its slate equals the org_membership_level owner slate.
- A4 pass, by policy:
  - absent / admin_rescue → pending [admin], the sole owner. `__resolvedFrom` records `admin_rescue:abandoned ['position:ops']` with the reason, plus an actorless system comment and a WARN.
  - fail → no request row, and the run fails `NO_APPROVERS`.
  - auto_approve → no row, the run completes and the approve-edge marker is written.
  - fallback to owner → [admin]; fallback to user Mei → [Mei], which discriminates.
  - a fallback that also resolves to nobody → admin_rescue.
- A5 pass: queue gives the not-implemented WARN, pending [admin], `abandoned ['queue:q_runa']`, and the request stays pending.
- N0–N4 pass.

### identity-auth.two-factor-enrollment-reveal
- A0 pass: the guard discriminates. On the armed boot (`OS_AUTH_TWO_FACTOR=true`), `/auth/config` reads `features.twoFactor:true` and `POST /two-factor/enable {}` → 400. On the unarmed control, it reads `twoFactor:false` and enable → 404.
- A1 pass: enable → 200 with `method, totpURI, backupCodes`. The URI is `otpauth://totp/` with label `ObjectStack:admin@objectos.ai` and `issuer=ObjectStack`. The secret is 52 base32 chars, which is 32 bytes. `digits=6`, `period=30`.
- A2 pass: `backupCodes` is a `string[]` of 10, shaped `xxxxx-xxxxx`.
- A3 pass: the `sys_two_factor.enable_two_factor` resultDialog paths resolve against the live response (string; `string[]` of 10).
- A4 pass (recorded): `get-totp-uri` returns 400 without a body, 400 `INVALID_PASSWORD` for a wrong password and 401 for anonymous. With the correct password it returns 200 and the **same** secret, both before and after verification. It is password-gated and re-reveals; the item's owed ruling stands.
- A5 pass: `sys_user.enable_two_factor` declares the qrcode and code-list fields and the acknowledge text, with no successMessage. Both paths resolve.
- N0 pass: a wrong-password or anonymous enable writes 0 rows.
- N1 pass, N2 pass.

### identity-auth.two-factor-backup-codes
- A0 pass: the enrollment was verified (`verify-totp` 200; `verified` went from 0 to 1, and `two_factor_enabled` is 1).
- A1 pass: the challenge sign-in returns `{twoFactorRedirect:true, twoFactorMethods:['totp']}` and sets only `better-auth.two_factor`; `get-session` mid-challenge is 401. A backup code → 200, then `get-session` 200.
- A2 pass: the same code at a fresh challenge → 401 `INVALID_BACKUP_CODE`; the control code → 200.
- A3 pass: `generate-backup-codes` → 200 with 10 new codes and no overlap. An unspent old code → 401, and a new one → 200.
- A4 pass (recorded): `backup_codes` is stored as a hex blob that is not JSON and contains no plaintext code. It was read from the DB file, because REST never returns the column, even to admin.
- A5 pass: `sys_user.generate_backup_codes` declares a code-list, the acknowledge text and `refreshAfter:false`, and the path resolves.
- N0–N3 pass: a wrong-password regenerate → 400 and anonymous → 401, and the refused regenerate was a no-op.

### identity-auth.two-factor-disable-lifecycle
- A0 pass: before, there is 1 row and the challenge fires.
- A1 pass: a wrong-password disable → 400 `INVALID_PASSWORD` with the state unchanged, and anonymous → 401.
- A2 pass: disable → 200, leaving 0 rows and the flag at 0.
- A3 pass: the next sign-in → 200 with no `twoFactorRedirect` and only `session_token`.
- A4 pass:
  - A retained code with no cookie → 401 `INVALID_TWO_FACTOR_COOKIE`; on a live session → 400 `BACKUP_CODES_NOT_ENABLED`.
  - Re-enable gives a new secret with no overlap.
  - An old-secret TOTP → 401 `INVALID_CODE` on both lanes; a new-secret TOTP → 200.
- A5 pass (recorded), with `mfa_required` on:
  - Disable → 200, not refused.
  - `mfa_required_at` is stamped lazily on the next request (a fresh 7-day grace).
  - With grace 0, a data read → 403 `MFA_REQUIRED` and `get-session` carries `authGate`, while `/two-factor/enable` and `verify-totp` stay reachable (200), after which data answers 200.
  - The stamp is not cleared on re-enrolment, matching source. Settings were restored.
- N0–N3 pass.

### search.rls-both-personas
- A0 pass: the recipe was replayed as written. The member's list is 200 with 0 rows, and by-id INV-1003 → 404. Member search `INV-1003` → [] with total 0; admin → [INV-1003] with total 1.
- A1 pass: paged `{search:'INV', limit:2}` reads:
  - skip 0 → 2 rows, total 3
  - skip 2 → 1 row, total 3
  - skip 4 and 6 → empty, total 3

  The total always equals the member's visible rows; the admin's is 15, which never leaks.
- A2 pass: the member's own 3 rows are found.
- A3 pass: deny, allow and own-row evidence are complete, through `expandSearchOnAst`.
- N0 pass.

### access-security.capability-declaration-lifecycle
- A0 pass: `GET /meta/capability/showcase.export_data` → 200 with the declared fields and scope `org`. `GET /data/sys_capability` → 404.
- A1 pass, on the action dispatcher:
  - `perm_held`: the ops member → 200; a non-granted member → 403 naming the missing capability; admin → 403.
  - `PUT /meta/permission/showcase_ops` → 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE`.
  - A clone with no label → 400; with a label → 200.
  - A member granted the clone → 200. Withdrawing the capability → 403 (twice); restoring it → 200, also within one live session.
  - `perm_missing` and `perm_and` → 403 for all personas, and `perm_empty` → 200 for all.
- A2 pass: a scratch app declaring `manage_users` passes `os validate` and `os build` (both exit 0). The boot then stops with `Security catalog name conflict … "manage_users" is already held by the platform`, and nothing listens.
- A3 pass:
  - `scope:'galaxy'` makes `os validate` exit 1, naming the path and the allowed values.
  - `PUT /meta/capability/NEW` → 403 `NOT_CREATABLE`.
  - `PUT` on a platform or package capability → 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE`.
  - The data door answers 404 for both GET and POST.
- N0–N4 pass.

### identity-auth.org-membership-team-management
- A0 pass: the Setup "Organization" nav targets the `sys_organization` record whose id equals `get-active-member.organizationId`. The record page renders the Members, Invitations and Teams tabs and the Invite, Rename and Edit actions (screenshot).
- A1 pass: as a member, create-team and invite-member → 403. After promotion to admin, invite → 200; after demotion, 403 again. `delegated_admin` and `owner` are accepted.
- A2 pass: `guest`, `contributor` and `showcase_ops` → 400 `ROLE_NOT_FOUND` on both doors, with no state change and no invitation row.
- A3 pass: rename → 200; the full-organization read, the data read and the page title all follow.
- A4 pass: remove-member → 200, and the old session → 401. A fresh sign-in gets 403 `USER_IS_NOT_A_MEMBER_OF_THE_ORGANIZATION` on get-full-organization and set-active. The member's sessions read `revoke_reason: organization_membership_ended`.
- A5 pass: create-team and add-team-member give unique rows (a duplicate add is idempotent). A generic `POST /data/sys_team_member` → 405.
- A6 pass: the forger gets 403 with its `YOU_ARE_NOT_ALLOWED_*` code on all 7 doors, and the snapshot is unchanged. The non-admin UI shows "You don't have access to this app", with no Organization nav.
- N0–N3 pass.

### search.pinyin-flag-both-sides
- A0 pass (ON): `zhangwei`/`zw`/`张` → 张伟, `wf` → 王芳, and `huaning`/`hnkj` → 华宁科技.
- A1 pass: the Latin-named contact at 华宁科技 is not found by `hnkj` or `huaningkeji` (0), while `华宁科技` finds 4 via the source column.
- A2 pass (OFF, explicit `false`): `zw`, `wf` and `hnkj` → 0, and `张` → 张伟. Latin source-column hits remain, with no errors.
- A3 pass: 53 plugins loaded with the flag on against 52 with it off; the diff is exactly `PinyinSearchPlugin`. The OFF log has 0 'pinyin' lines once the runner's own file-path lines are excluded.
- A4 pass: on first boot, the companion hooks are bound and reconcile updated 1 account and 3 contacts; the ON queries hit with no rebuild.
- N0 pass, N1 pass.
- Step 5 (no clause): list quick-search `search=zw` showed only 张伟.

### i18n.strict-translation-key-rejection
- A0 pass: all 10 variants → 422 `INVALID_METADATA` via `PUT /api/v1/meta/translation/zh_cn_qa`. Each `issues[]` entry names the surface and echoes the key.
- A1 pass: `defineTranslation` (`/system`) and `defineTranslationBundle` (root) both throw for all 10, and accept the valid doc.
- A2 pass: "Did you mean `helpText` → `help`?" and "`label` → `title`?" appear at both doors.
- A3 pass: each retired key points at its replacement home: objects / apps / navigation / dashboards, `object.validations[].message`, ADR-0049 with spec 17.0.0, and the top-level `locale`.
- A4 pass: a rejected save on a fresh name reads back 404. Three rejected saves over a saved baseline leave the baseline unchanged.
- A5 pass: on a zh-CN session, the record-page type badge reads `任务（QA-runB）` and the New dialog `新建任务（QA-runB）`.
- N0 pass, N1 pass.

### approvals.decision-action-matrix
- A0 pass: each of the nine variants answers 200, and each appends exactly one `/:id/actions` row naming the actor and the action.
